**Mongrels** are creatures found in Appalachia.

Mongrels are commonly found throughout the region. They are aggressive and will hunt anything nearby. They will only perform standard bite and claw attacks. Usually traveling in a group, they will attack from all directions.

- A small pack of three will spawn on the road from the Overseer's Camp to Green Country Lodge.
- A group will always appear next to the windmill on the hill north of Becker Farm.
- A group will always appear on the hills north of the Whitespring Golf Club.
- A group will always appear near a makeshift bar on top of the hill north of Grafton Station, east of the makeshift vault, and southwest of Woods Estate.
- During the Handy Walker random encounter.
- Chance to be found outside of Slocum's Joe.
- Chance to be found south of Sutton Station.
- Chance to be found at White Powder Winter Sports.
- Chance to be found east of Gorge Junkyard.
- Chance to be found at the Isolated Cabin.

The wild mongrel is a possible Vox Syringer target during Daily: Someone To Talk To.

- *"I can't wait to eat you!"*
- *"Ow."* (if attacked)
- *"Ow. My leg."* (if shot in the leg)

Mongrels appear in *Fallout 76*.
